messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD-3214 — prod-db-main: Postgres connection queueing > 120s, p95 write latency 1.3s. Alert rule: `db.conn_queue_time > 60s`

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-3214 has been triggered. Escalation policy: oncall-db -> oncall-sre. Paging sara (oncall).

sara (oncall): ack. I’m on it — pulling up graphs now. Can someone drop recent deploys?

nick_dba: Not seeing any deploys in the last 30m from deploy logs. Last schema migration was earlier today at 02:10 UTC but no write-heavy changes.

ali: checking redis and rds metrics in datadog. CPU and network look normal for redis-primary but conn count on Postgres is spiking.

mike_reliability: Confirming: connection queue length at the proxy layer is high. Looks like pg-bouncer on prod-proxy-1 is at max_client_conn and queueing requests.

sara (oncall): ok can we get `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active';` and `SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity ORDER BY state_change DESC LIMIT 10;` from prod-db-main?

nick_dba: running now.

nick_dba: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active';
-- result: 432
SELECT pid, usename, state, query_start, application_name FROM pg_stat_activity ORDER BY query_start DESC LIMIT 10;
-- many clients stuck on `BEGIN` from app-worker pool, app-name=redwood-api
```

jen_support: getting a couple customer reports about slow write performance on embeddings creation and chat logs flush. Ticket numbers: #4521, #4523. Not widespread but a couple of high-traffic customers impacted.

ali: redis latency spiking on a few keys used for rate-limiting, but overall redis-connected clients are ok. The immediate bottleneck looks Postgres connections.

sara (oncall): switching traffic to standbys? What's replication lag on replica-1? We can redirect some read-heavy flows, but writes have to hit primary. Any long-running transactions?

nick_dba: replication lag is <50ms. There are several long-running idle-in-transaction sessions from `api-ingest-6` that have open transactions for >30s. Killing those should free up slots. Proposing to terminate top offenders: pids 10234, 10237, 10240.

mike_reliability: before killing, can we throttle incoming API workers to give DB time to catch up? I can flip a feature flag to reduce ingestion concurrency for the next 5 minutes.

ali: I can push a temporary config to rate-limit ingestion worker concurrency from 20 -> 4 on the prod autoscale group. Doing it now.

sara (oncall): go for it. Nick, after you kill those pids, watch for immediate queue drop and reconnect churn.

nick_dba: killed pids 10234,10237,10240. Noted they're from `api-ingest-6`.

incident-bot: :information_source: Action logged: killed 3 sessions by nick_dba.

mike_reliability: flipped feature flag to reduce ingestion concurrency. Should propagate in ~30s.

ali: seeing queue length drop at proxy from ~420 -> ~80 in 45s. p95 write latency down to 350ms. Redis rate-limit errors at the app dropped too.

sara (oncall): nice. Monitoring for 5m. Can we add a temporary autoscale policy increase for DB connection limit? PgBouncer has max_client_conn set conservative for memory reasons. If we raise it, risk more memory, but may avoid queueing. Thoughts?

nick_dba: we can raise `max_client_conn` by 20% on proxies but need to monitor tail memory on primary. I'll prepare a change but want to keep it short-lived.

jen_support: letting the 2 impacted customers know we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA. :thumbsup:

oncall-followup-bot: oncall follow-up reminder set: create incident report draft in #postmortems within 24h.

sara (oncall): leaving a note for next handoff: if queueing comes back after rollback of FF, escalate to full db incident and notify sales (high-touch customers). For now, I'll keep monitoring and if stable in 10m I'll close the page.

mike_reliability: can we add a short-term alert mute for noisy redis rate-limit spikes tied to worker overload? Otherwise we'll keep noisy alerts while we recover.

ali: added a 10m suppression for the related redis alert rule.

nick_dba: rolling change: bumping pgbouncer `max_client_conn` from 2000 -> 2400 on proxy-1 only (manual). Applying now.\n
nick_dba: applied. Memory on proxy-1 increased by ~60MB, within safe limits. Connections accepted rising, queue continues to fall.

sara (oncall): p95 write latency now 210ms, queue ~10. Good. Marking PD-3214 acknowledged/resolved but keeping watch for 30m.

pagerduty: PD-3214 acknowledged by sara (oncall) and marked as resolved (condition cleared).

jen_support: Sent customers an interim update. Will attach timeline and next steps in postmortem.

sara (oncall): handing off to mike_reliability for overnight watch and RCA follow-up. If anything spikes, page the same escalation. Thanks team. :coffee: 

mike_reliability: thanks — I'll keep watch and start RCA with nick tomorrow. Leaving notes in the incident doc.

oncall-followup-bot: Handoff logged: from sara (oncall) to mike_reliability at 2026-11-18T22:13:10Z. Reminder to draft RCA.

incident-bot: Thread closed (no new activity)
